findings.description: The handler performs a destructive database action (deleting a user) with no authentication or authorization check. Any unauthenticated caller can delete any user by posting a userId. This route must be protected — at minimum verify the session, and given it lives under /admin/, verify the caller has an admin role before executing the delete.

userId is used directly without validation. It should be validated as a well-formed identifier (e.g. UUID) before being passed to db.user.delete; otherwise malformed input can cause Prisma to throw an unhelpful error and leak internals to the client.
